pipeline.title: Taiho scores phase 3 win with oral cancer combo for AML-causing blood disorders
pipeline.summary: The oral combination treatment delivered the same exposure to azacitidine as when the chemo was given subcutaneously—meeting Taiho’s primary endpoint.

pipeline.title: Lilly gives deeper glimpse at Foundayo's heart-helping odds in diabetes, obesity phase 3
pipeline.summary: In a new update, Lilly tied Foundayo to a 53% reduction in the risk of cardiovascular death and a 57% lower risk of all-cause mortality compared with insulin glargine in a preplanned analysis of its phase 3 Achieve-4 trial.

pipeline.title: Patient death in BMS pulmonary fibrosis trial raises questions, but analysts unshaken
pipeline.summary: The revelation of a patient death in Bristol Myers Squibb’s phase 3 trial of a potential pulmonary fibrosis treatment has raised concerns ahead of the study’s readout, but analysts were quick to dispel worries about broader implications for the drug mechanism involved.

pipeline.title: Foghorn lays off 40% of employees as Lilly cancer collab collapses over poor data
pipeline.summary: Foghorn Therapeutics is laying off 40% of its workforce after a long-running collaboration with Eli Lilly collapsed over disappointing phase 1 data.

pipeline.title: Zealand's stock slides as Boehringer-partnered obesity drug underwhelms again in phase 3
pipeline.summary: A phase 3 trial of Boehringer Ingelheim’s survodutide in people with obesity and Type 2 diabetes has met its co-primary endpoints. Yet, with the readout echoing earlier data that underwhelmed analysts, shares in Boehringer’s partner Zealand Pharma fell 12% in early trading in Den

pipeline.title: Merck’s anti-TL1A antibody secures a win in ph. 2 hidradenitis suppurativa trial
pipeline.summary: Merck & Co. touted a win for its anti-TL1A antibody in a phase 2b trial in patients with moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa (HS).

pipeline.title: Connect’s Dupixent rival reduces COPD attacks by 85%, but misses a secondary goal
pipeline.summary: Connect Biopharma has pointed to phase 2 data for its IL-4/IL-13 blocker as proof that the wannabe Dupixent rival can reduce respiratory attacks—although the study missed a secondary endpoint tied to a breathing test.

pipeline.title: Roche, Zealand see phase 2 amylin weight loss peak at mid-dose, start pivotal program
pipeline.summary: Zealand Pharma has shared primary endpoint data on Roche-partnered petrelintide, revealing that the middle dose of the amylin analog delivered the highest weight loss—9.8%—at Week 28.

pipeline.title: Amgen reveals 6-point drop in lupus severity behind phase 2 win for Horizon antibody
pipeline.summary: Amgen has shed light on its phase 2 lupus win, revealing that its monoclonal antibody daxdilimab was tied to a 6-point reduction in disease severity at the lower dose.

pipeline.title: Lilly sets up next-gen obesity battle with full phase 3 retatrutide data
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly has shared detailed data from a phase 3 retatrutide trial, revealing that more than one-third of patients on the top dose of the triple-G drug candidate lost at least 25% of their body weight.

pipeline.title: Canadian $5M accelerated clinical trial program cuts start-up to 45 days
pipeline.summary: A newly launched $5 million clinical trial program allows clinical trial sponsors to start trials in as little as 45 days in Ontario.

pipeline.title: Highlight Therapeutics illuminates positive ph. 2 topline data in high-risk skin cancer
pipeline.summary: Highlight Therapeutics touted positive topline results in patients with localized high-risk head and neck basal cell carcinoma (BCC).

pipeline.title: Sanofi, Regeneron broaden alliance to find their next Dupixent
pipeline.summary: The deal carries a $1 billion upfront payment and tasks the two companies to develop long-acting antibody drugs that go after the same targets as their blockbuster anti-inflammation agent.

pipeline.title: Roche launches simultaneous screening test for SMA, SCID, and SCD
pipeline.summary: Roche Diagnostics has launched a new in vitro diagnostic test for newborn screening to detect a series of rare disorders.

pipeline.title: 5 FDA decisions to watch in the fourth quarter of 2026
pipeline.summary: The next three months will feature anticipated decisions on a new kind of cancer immunotherapy, as well as medicines important to the futures of Roche, GSK and Gilead.

pipeline.title: Johnson & Johnson survey finds women not connecting menopause to eye health changes
pipeline.summary: Hot flashes, mood and sleep disturbances are common themes for menopause: But vision changes are not one that makes the list of common symptoms. Now, J&J is looking to highlight this often-overlooked issue.

pipeline.title: Asahi Kasei wraps years of global dealmaking into a single brand
pipeline.summary: After years of deal-driven global expansion, Asahi Kasei is rolling its pharma units up under a single brand and forging ahead with efforts to drive sales toward $2 billion by the end of the decade.

pipeline.title: Sanofi pays Dupixent partner Regeneron $1B upfront for 4 early-stage assets to ignite R&D
pipeline.summary: Sanofi is paying Regeneron $1 billion upfront to collaborate on four early-stage immunology programs, teeing the longstanding partners up to try to replicate Dupixent’s success.

pipeline.title: Real Chemistry launches AI-powered MaestroHCP to conduct omnichannel campaigns
pipeline.summary: Real Chemistry has created an artificial intelligence-enabled platform to improve a manual, fragmented stage of the omnichannel marketing process.

pipeline.title: CMS finalizes model that aims to bring most-favored nation pricing to Part B
pipeline.summary: The Trump administration has finalized a new model that aims to bring its most-favored nation pricing approach to Medicare Part B.

pipeline.title: Organon beams up 'Skin Science' in sci-fi themed Vtama campaign
pipeline.summary: Organon leaned into non-steriod skin cream Vtama's first-in-class status for a science-fiction themed HCP marketing campaign, complete with aliens and UFOs.

pipeline.title: FDA hits 2nd Fresenius site with contamination-related warning letter in less than a month
pipeline.summary: The agency raised concerns about contamination and quality control at Fresenius Kabi's Melrose Park facility in Illinois.

pipeline.title: BioMarin lays off 117 California workers to consolidate footprint
pipeline.summary: Just months after trimming jobs in New Jersey following an acquisition, BioMarin is laying off 117 employees in California as part of a consolidation of its footprint.

pipeline.title: Novo trims 108 jobs at US headquarters in New Jersey
pipeline.summary: Come year’s end, more than 100 Novo employees reporting to the Danish drugmaker’s outpost in Plainsboro, New Jersey, will be headed for the exit.

pipeline.title: Lilly raises diabetes weight-loss bar with amylin-Zepbound combo
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly announced its amylin-Zepbound combination eloraTZP resulted in 23.3% weight loss in adults with type 2 diabetes and obesity or overweight, topping its own triple-G drug candidate retatrutide in that population.

pipeline.title: Bristol Myers trial revisions shake confidence in new class of fibrosis drugs
pipeline.summary: A spokesperson confirmed that a “limited number” of liver-related safety events, including a patient death, were observed in testing of Bristol Myers’ admilparant — though it’s unclear whether the drug was to blame.

pipeline.title: FDA starts review of Roche’s multiple sclerosis pill
pipeline.summary: The FDA previously hadn’t ever accepted an application of a drug like fenebrutinib in two major forms of MS. But safety questions still hang over Roche’s program.

pipeline.title: Varda brings home $251M series D to fuel space-based drug manufacturing
pipeline.summary: The start-up, which deploys unmanned, reusable rockets into Earth’s low-orbit, secured another $251 million in a series D funding round.

pipeline.title: Vanda lines up new expansion prospect for Hetlioz as FDA jet lag hearing looms
pipeline.summary: As Vanda Pharmaceuticals awaits a long-sought hearing with the FDA around a potential Hetlioz label expansion into jet lag disorder, the melatonin receptor agonist has demonstrated its merit in another sleep indication with a current dearth of treatment options.

pipeline.title: Beam Therapeutics sues base editing rival, claims former scientist stole secrets
pipeline.summary: Base editing biotech Beam Therapeutics is suing one of its newest rivals, alleging that the upstart company stole the secrets behind one of its lead programs and used them to craft a competing therapy.

pipeline.title: Hansoh’s Tagrisso rival loses EU approval after AstraZeneca legal challenge
pipeline.summary: The European Commission has revoked the EU marketing authorization for Hansoh Pharma’s EGFR lung cancer drug Aumseqa following a legal challenge from rival AstraZeneca.

pipeline.title: PhRMA names next CEO; Pierre Fabre takes third swing at Ebvallo approval
pipeline.summary: A former congressman will take over for prominent lobbyist Steve Ubl. Elsewhere, recent buyout deals paid dividends for Mirum and AbbVie.

pipeline.title: GSK continues to stock up on Wave's RNA drugs with liver-focused program
pipeline.summary: GSK is paying Wave Life Sciences $12 million upfront to take ownership of a hepatic program arising from the companies’ long-running collaboration.

pipeline.title: CSL Seqirus boasts bigger batch of flu vaccines ahead of US flu season
pipeline.summary: CSL Seqirus, a unit of the Australian biopharma CSL, touted the availability of more influenza vaccines in the U.S. ahead of the impending flu season.

pipeline.title: VertigoDx on firm ground with FDA greenlight for vertigo diagnostic system
pipeline.summary: The FDA  has granted 510(k) clearance to Miami-based VertigoDx for its portable diagnostic system that can evaluate vertigo, including benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPVV).

pipeline.title: Alnylam drafts football veteran Pete Shaw for heart disease education push
pipeline.summary: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals has teamed up with Pete Shaw, making the retired professional football player the star of its “Play by Play” educational heart disease initiative.

pipeline.title: NorthStar locks down $185M as radiopharmaceutical isotope, CDMO expansion plans advance
pipeline.summary: Book ended by its first commercial-scale manufacturing of the radioisotope actinium-225 in January and an expected high-capacity production line launch by the end of the year, radiopharmaceutical supplier and CDMO NorthStar Medical Technologies has secured a hefty chunk of change

pipeline.title: Beam sues 2 biotechs, alleging theft of base editing trade secrets
pipeline.summary: Beam claimed a former scientist stole confidential information and quietly spun up a rival rare disease treatment at YolTech Therapeutics. Serapha Bio, which licensed that therapy, denies the charges.

pipeline.title: PhRMA locks in former House Majority Leader Cantor as next CEO
pipeline.summary: Following news of a planned CEO departure for the United States’ top drug industry lobbying group, PhRMA has tapped a new leader well versed in navigating disagreements and reaching consensus with those in the U.S. halls of power.

pipeline.title: White House lays groundwork to reshore production of 86 essential medicines
pipeline.summary: The White House is asking pharma manufacturers to provide details on their domestic capacity as it moves forward with an initiative that will increase stateside production of 86 key medicines over the next 18 months.

pipeline.title: Enanta sheds staffers as key antiviral, immunology readouts loom
pipeline.summary: As antiviral specialist Enanta Pharmaceuticals endeavors to expand into immunology, the company has decided to lay off 37 employees, Fierce has learned.

pipeline.title: Novo to pay Hengrui up to $2.6B for a once-weekly obesity pill
pipeline.summary: The deal, which hands Novo a challenger to Lilly’s market-leading Zepbound, comes as the Danish drugmaker looks to calm investor fears about its future.

pipeline.title: Big Pharma's Big Brand: Regeneron's science-driven communications approach
pipeline.summary: Regeneron looks for "different entry points" to introduce audiences to its science, SVP of corporate affairs Christina Chan explained in an interview.

pipeline.title: UniQure tumbles with latest data for Huntington’s gene therapy
pipeline.summary: Analysts guessed that investors wanted to see stronger durability results at a four-year check-in of the key trial supporting a potential approval of "AMT-130."

pipeline.title: Novo, Lilly pit their GLP-1s against one another in diabetes and obesity as EASD kicks off in Milan
pipeline.summary: In Milan this week, Novo and Eli Lilly took the stage at the European Association for the Study of Diabetes 2026 meeting with dueling datasets on oral and injectable GLP-1s.

pipeline.title: US details rules for 0% specialty pharmaceutical tariff exemptions
pipeline.summary: Before broad 100% tariffs on imported pharmaceuticals take full effect today, the Trump administration has detailed rules that allow certain specialty drugs, including orphan treatments, nuclear medicines, cell and gene therapies, and ADCs, to enter the U.S. duty-free.

pipeline.title: uniQure stock crashes as Huntington’s gene therapy data weaken
pipeline.summary: uniQure’s Huntington’s disease gene therapy has failed to significantly slow disease progression after 48 months, sending the biotech’s stock down 41% when trading began. But mitigating circumstances and the ongoing strength of a secondary endpoint kept analysts optimistic about

pipeline.title: ai3Bio, built from two biotechs, pursues a different path to an ‘immune reset’
pipeline.summary: Rather than deplete malfunctioning B cells as many other emerging autoimmune drugs do, Ai3Bio’s therapies are designed to eliminate a particular group of T helper cells.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca invests $2B in Summit, gaining ‘seat at the table’ for PD-1/VEGF drug push
pipeline.summary: The equity investment comes alongside a deal to test Summit’s ivonescimab alongside potentially many AstraZeneca drugs — but doesn’t hand the pharmaceutical company any ownership rights.

pipeline.title: Biopharma recruiters see ‘signs of recovery’ as layoffs remain cool in Q3’26
pipeline.summary: A more subdued volume of biopharma layoffs continued into the third quarter of 2026, validating predictions that the sector has moved beyond the avalanche of redundancies experienced last year.

pipeline.title: Inizio Evoke names new leaders in media, AI and client accounts
pipeline.summary: Inizio Evoke has unveiled a trio of appointments, installing leaders across its media, artificial intelligence and client relationship teams.

pipeline.title: Audien beams up William Shatner to boldly boost OTC hearing aid awareness
pipeline.summary: William Shatner has partnered with Audien Hearing to “Boldly Hear What’s Next.” The alliance makes the “Star Trek” actor the face of a campaign for Audien’s over-the-counter hearing aids.

pipeline.title: Novo agrees $2.6B deal for preclinical GLP-1/GIP drug from in-demand Hengrui
pipeline.summary: Novo’s ongoing efforts to rejuvenate its pipeline have seen the Big Pharma turn to one of the most in-demand drug developers in China.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca scales Summit’s PD-1xVEGF strategy with $2B investment to fuel ADC combos
pipeline.summary: AstraZeneca is investing $2 billion in Summit Therapeutics to accelerate the development of PD-1xVEGF bispecific ivonescimab in combination with antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). The newly minted partners will start by testing ivonescimab with AstraZeneca’s CLDN18.2-directed ADC i

pipeline.title: ‘We’re so close to the tech companies’: Genentech CEO talks Fierce through vision for the future
pipeline.summary: When recombinant DNA pioneer Herbert Boyer, Ph.D., first got a call from venture capitalist Robert Swanson about starting a company, the savvy scientist wasn’t sure a meeting would be worth his time.

pipeline.title: ai3Bio emerging from stealth to ‘take the gun out of the hands of the immune system’
pipeline.summary: ai3Bio has emerged from stealth with $48 million in funding and a buzzing platform for targeting T cells in autoimmune disease.

pipeline.title: Regulatory tracker: Pierre Fabre refiles rare disease drug after agreement with FDA
pipeline.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: Foghorn cuts workforce by 40%; BioMarin drops 117 roles
pipeline.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker '26: TriGemX tacks on $94M; AnaCardio adds $71M
pipeline.summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.
